items.snippet: Americký soud schválil dohodu, podle které německý agrochemický gigant Bayer zaplatí během dvou desetiletí až 7,25 miliardy dolarů (zhruba 161 miliard korun) za urovnání žalob ohledně herbicidu Roundup. items.title: Ukraine blocks Russian climate report containing data from occupied territories at COP31
items.snippet: At the UN Climate Change Conference COP31 in Antalya, the Ukrainian delegation blocked consideration of an agenda item concerning Russia's inclusion of data from temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories in its climate reporting.

54% of damaged healthcare infrastructure facilities restored in Chernihiv region
items.snippet: A total of 100 healthcare and social welfare facilities in Ukraine's Chernihiv region have been damaged by enemy shelling. So far, 54% of those facilities have been restored, while another 10% are being rebuilt.

items.title: Bringing equipment repairs closer to front line: NATO and Ukraine developing enhanced repair centers
items.snippet: NATO and Ukraine are developing a concept for enhanced repair centers that would bring industrial and logistical capabilities closer to the front line, enabling faster repairs and the quicker return of equipment to the battlefield.

items.title: Russia lacks technical capacity to repair Crimean Bridge – Pletenchuk
items.snippet: Russia currently lacks the technical capacity needed to repair the Kerch Strait Bridge. The alternatives for travel to temporarily occupied Crimea remain a land route through the occupied territories of the Azov region and ferry crossings.

items.title: Russia launches up to 200 attack drones nightly and more than 100 during the day – Ihnat
items.snippet: Russian forces are attacking Ukraine with strike drones virtually around the clock, launching more than 100 during the day and up to 200 at night. On some days, jet-powered UAVs account for as much as 95% of the total.

items.title: Porota v USA shledala vinným muže podezřelého ze založení požáru v Los Angeles
items.snippet: Americká porota shledala vinným třicetiletého muže podezřelého z úmyslného založení požáru, který se rozrostl v „jednu z největších katastrof v historii Los Angeles“. Informovaly o tom zpravodajské agentury. Požár loni v lednu způsobil smrt dvanácti lidem a zničil tisíce budov.
